d:
Tejasvi yadav ko nishant kumar, sanjay jha aur vijay chaudhri ki or se mili badhaee ne bihar ki siyasat men naee charcha chher di hai. aakhir in netaon ne tejasvi ko badhaee dekar bijepi ko kya rajnitik sandesh diya hai? badhaee ke pichhe ke siyasi mayne samjhie is khas riport men.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
